visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use finally Instead of Scattered Steps
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The failure is remembered in a flag and the message and the final line are printed afterwards in a fixed order. Use a try / catch / finally. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The error handling now sits in the catch block where the error happens, and finally guarantees the closing line even if another exception or an early return occurs. No flag variable is needed.
